select tab.* from ( SELECT c.contract_number, c.contract_name, c.contract_id, 'CON_CONTRACT' document_category, (SELECT DESCRIPTION FROM hls_business_type WHERE business_type = c.business_type AND document_category = c.document_category) business_type_desc, (SELECT bp_name FROM hls_bp_master WHERE bp_id = c.tenant_id) seller_or_tenant, (SELECT wm_concat(h.bp_name) FROM hls_bp_master h, prj_project_bp pb WHERE h.bp_id = pb.bp_id AND pb.bp_type = 'TENANT_SEC' AND pb.bp_categroy = 'CON_CONTRACT' AND pb.project_id = c.project_id) buyer_or_tenant_sec, (SELECT currency_name FROM fnd_currency fc WHERE fc.currency_code = c.currency) currency_name, c.lease_item_amount contract_amount, (SELECT SUM(ccc.due_amount - nvl(ccc.received_amount, 0)) FROM con_contract_cashflow ccc WHERE ccc.contract_id = c.contract_id AND ccc.cf_item = 1) unreceived_rental, (SELECT SUM(ccc.principal - nvl(ccc.received_principal, 0)) FROM con_contract_cashflow ccc WHERE ccc.contract_id = c.contract_id AND ccc.cf_item = 1) unreceived_principal, (SELECT SUM(ccc.interest - nvl(ccc.received_interest, 0)) FROM con_contract_cashflow ccc WHERE ccc.contract_id = c.contract_id AND ccc.cf_item = 1) unreceived_interest, c.lease_start_date, (SELECT MAX(due_date) FROM con_contract_cashflow WHERE contract_id = c.contract_id) lease_end_date FROM con_contract c WHERE c.data_class = 'NORMAL' AND c.contract_status IN ('INCEPT') UNION ALL SELECT fc.contract_number, fc.contract_name, fc.contract_id, 'FCT_CONTRACT' document_category, (SELECT DESCRIPTION FROM hls_business_type WHERE business_type = fc.business_type AND document_category = fc.document_category) business_type_desc, (SELECT wm_concat(h.bp_name) FROM hls_bp_master h, fct_project_bp fb WHERE h.bp_id = fb.bp_id AND fb.project_id = fc.project_id AND bp_role_type = 'SELLER') seller_or_tenant, (SELECT wm_concat(h.bp_name) FROM hls_bp_master h, fct_project_bp fb WHERE h.bp_id = fb.bp_id AND fb.project_id = fc.project_id AND bp_role_type = 'BUYER') buyer_or_tenant_sec, (SELECT currency_name FROM fnd_currency fcy WHERE fcy.currency_code = fc.currency) currency_name, fc.finance_amount contract_amount, (SELECT SUM(fqc.due_amount - nvl(fqc.write_off_amount, 0)) FROM fct_quotation_cashflow fqc WHERE fqc.contract_id = fc.contract_id AND fqc.cf_item IN (54, 55)) unreceived_rental, (SELECT SUM(fqc.due_amount - nvl(fqc.write_off_amount, 0)) FROM fct_quotation_cashflow fqc WHERE fqc.contract_id = fc.contract_id AND fqc.cf_item = 54) unreceived_principal, (SELECT SUM(fqc.due_amount - nvl(fqc.write_off_amount, 0)) FROM fct_quotation_cashflow fqc WHERE fqc.contract_id = fc.contract_id AND fqc.cf_item = 55) unreceived_interest, fc.valid_from lease_start_date, fc.rate_valid_to lease_end_date FROM fct_contract fc WHERE fc.data_class = 'NORMAL' AND fc.contract_status IN ('INCEPT')) tab where 1=1
and tab.contract_number like concat(concat('%',#{contractNumber}),'%')
and tab.contract_name like concat(concat('%',#{contractName}),'%')
